This is especially true for people with diabetes. Find out how to store and use insulin in an emergency. In a power outage when refrigerated insulin isn't available: Try to keep your insulin cool, but make sure not to freeze it. Insulin that has been frozen can break down and will be less effective. Keep your insulin away from direct heat and out of direct sunlight. Heat and sunlight will also make it less effective.
